messages:
olivia-support: heads-up — ACME reporting 404s when calling embeddings with ts-sdk v0.18.1. They say the SDK is sending an `engine` param but our API now expects `model`. Repro + logs below. anyone seen this?

olivia-support: repro (from their app):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.embeddings.create({ engine: 'r-instruct-1', input: ['hello'] });
```
response: HTTP 404 {"error":"Not Found","message":"/v1/embeddings endpoint not found for provided params"}
server log snippet: `req_id=abc123 v=0.18.1 payload={engine:"r-instruct-1",input:[..]}`

sam-eng: can you paste the request_id and full raw request/headers? also confirm sdk exact version string from package-lock/yarn.lock. this smells like a param rename mismatch.

olivia-support: request_id abc123, headers show `x-sdk-version: 0.18.1`. raw body posted above (engine key).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out breaking-change: embeddings param rename (engine -> model) on 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC. Backwards-compat shim disabled for old clients.

cheng-devx: yep — we intentionally removed automatic `engine`->`model` mapping in the API to avoid ambiguous semantics, but SDK v0.18.x should have included a client-side shim. looks like v0.18.1 missed it. options: 1) quick API-side compatibility acceptor for `engine` (hotfix) 2) ship patch SDK v0.18.2 that maps engine->model before serializing 3) ask customer to upgrade to v0.19.0 which already sends `model`.

olivia-support: customer wants a short-term workaround they can apply without changing many apps. they asked if we can tell them a minimal change.

cheng-devx: workaround for them (one-line): instead of `client.embeddings.create({ engine: 'r-instruct-1', input })` call the raw route or pass `model` explicitly — e.g.:
```ts
// workaround without upgrading SDK
await client.request('POST', '/v1/embeddings', { model: 'r-instruct-1', input });
```
This bypasses the old helper which still expects `engine` in v0.18.1.

marcus-se: we should offer them either the temporary API hotfix (we accept `engine` for ~7 days) or the SDK patch. propose: hotfix for 24-48h while we publish v0.18.2 and notify customers. i'll draft the message and CS T&Cs for the hotfix window.

sam-eng: i can open a PR for the SDK shim now — small change in serializer. i can have v0.18.2 published to npm in ~2h. also will add a deprecation console.warn when engine is detected. PR: <link internal: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/PR/2345>

cheng-devx: +1 to both. i'll also add an ingress rule to accept `engine` on the API edge for 48h (no public docs) so customers on older clients don't break immediately. we'll log and trigger a warning to our deprecation telemetry.

olivia-support: perfect. i'll tell ACME: (1) temporary API acceptance enabled for 48h, (2) suggestion to call raw route as short-term workaround, (3) recommended to upgrade to v0.19.0 or apply v0.18.2 when released. will offer to coordinate a safe upgrade window.

marcus-se: assign to eng-runtime + devx for patch + hotfix. will follow up with timeline and post to #status if we extend beyond 48h.

olivia-support: thanks all — will update ACME and close the ticket once v0.18.2 is out. :thumbsup:
_notes: thread covers TS SDK v0.18.1 sending legacy 'engine' param -> API expects 'model'; includes repro, logs, workaround, hotfix plan, and owner assignments
